title: Don't Stop Believin’ · 4/4
description: Count 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &. Tempo counts quarter notes. Learn one hand at a time, then combine a short section.
fingeringNote: Finger numbers are practice suggestions. Allow the hand to move between positions; do not hold a stretched shape. For repeated left-hand octaves, use a single bass note if the reach is uncomfortable.
